# Apocalypse of Peter — Chapter 3
**Agent:** PNEUMA (Dynamic)
**Source:** Akhmim Fragment / Ethiopic MS, Apocalypse of Peter 3

---

1. When he finished speaking, I fell on my face and wept. "Lord," I said, "is it really possible? Can a person who has sinned repent and still be saved? And what about those who die without ever turning back?"

2. The Lord answered: "The sinners will repent when they see the ones who were believed in. And those who never believed will see those who did believe — and they will be overwhelmed with shame at their own unbelief.

3. Those who repent will be saved. They will live alongside the righteous in the glory of my Father. But those who dig in and refuse to repent — they will be judged and sentenced to punishment that fits what they have done."

4. I said: "Lord, let me see it. Show me what happens to souls — the sinners and the righteous — at the moment they leave this world."

5. The Lord showed me a great angel. He was terrifying to look at, and he held a flaming sword in his right hand; fire streamed from his very body.

6. Two other angels stood at his sides, and above them another — blazing, glorious, outshining the rest. These were the ones given charge over the souls of sinners.

7. On the other side: angels luminous and robed in light, receiving the souls of the righteous as they arrived, while the righteous praised God with a mighty voice.

8. The angel of righteousness brought the righteous souls forward and placed them before me. Their faces — they shone like the sun.

9. "Who are these?" I asked.

10. The Lord said: "These are your brothers — the righteous. You don't know everything they did in this life. But I do."

11. "And the sinners, Lord? Where are they taken?"

12. "The sinners are handed to the angel of punishment," he said, "and they are brought to the place of torment."

---
*PNEUMA note: The contrasting processions of righteous and sinners is staged as a dramatic diptych. The angel's fire-streaming body is given sensory weight.*
